The Pelicans defeated the Jazz, 120-113 tonight in New Orleans. Zion Williamson finished with a team-high 23 points along with 4 rebounds and 2 assists for the Pelicans, while Saddiq Bey tallied 22 points, 4 rebounds and 3 assists in the game. Keyonte George recorded 39 points, 9 assists and 4 steals. The Pelicans improve their record to 4-4 with the win, while the Jazz fall to 1-7 for the season.
